method: X 新品挖掘日报 2026-08-09 · manual curation under STANDARD (1c new-window channel)
title: Soloop — approval-gated 'agent OS' for solo founders (PH #2)
gap: The 'AI employee' family is crowded but splits into chat-toys and full-auto agents nobody trusts with real work. The middle — agents do, the human signs — matches how founders actually delegate, and nobody owns it yet.

_watch.hypothesis: solo founders' bandwidth pain — a long-verified category, independent of this product
_watch.why_now: agent reliability plus the approval-gate UX pattern just matured enough to delegate real multi-step work
_watch.trigger: first-hand 'it actually finished my work' user voices, or public retention / paying-user numbers

zh.gap: 市面上要么是只会聊天的玩具，要么是全自动、没人敢放手让它干真事的 agent。中间那层——它干、你签字——没人占住。
zh.pain: 一个人的公司，CEO、CTO、CMO 是同一个下午的同一个人。累的不是哪件活，是每份草稿、每个决定都堵在你一个人身上。
zh.kill: 如果审阅它干的活比自己动手还费神，审批就成了新的堵点，这事直接塌掉。
zh.move: 砍掉花哨的组织架构，只做一个「待签收件箱」：每天一列干完待你点头的活。

pain: A solo founder is CEO, CTO and CMO in the same afternoon. The pain isn't any single task — it's that every draft, decision and follow-up queues behind one person's attention.
kill: 19 likes on launch day, zero retention evidence, and this family's graveyard is full of agent-org demos that died in week two. If reviewing agent output costs more attention than doing the task, approval becomes the new bottleneck and the premise collapses; every incumbent agent product is one 'approval inbox' feature away.
move: If the trigger fires: strip the org-chart metaphor, ship only the approval inbox — a daily queue of agent-finished work to sign. Cold start CN: 即刻「独立开发者」圈 / 小红书「一人公司」话题; EN: Indie Hackers + r/EntrepreneurRideAlong build-logs.
